review_work: Read all 66 grouped saved English/Japanese explanations and five range summaries against their exact board and public history.

Performed a new limited combinatorial rank check for claimed no-one-card straight completion, gutshots, open-ended draws and selected pair categories; the direct contradiction found was the four 85s turn BTN combos.
Confirmed river BTN exclusive 54 claim is consistent with saved river BB check conditioning: river BB 54 takes bet125 at 100%, leaving zero 54 reach after check.

Inspected public loader allowlist and content-addressed hash binding, bilingual reason selection, named base65+20 publication checks, own-reach reconstruction and missing-path no-substitution behavior.
evidence.mutations: Only this new review-report file was created; original artifacts, policies and saved reasons were not changed.

limitations: This is a scoped prerelease review, not a solver/GTO proof, exploitability measurement or certification of all strategies.
No blanket semantic approval of all 85 preflop scenes or their complete bilingual reason corpus is given.
Combined publication payload SHA and exact release-plan identity were not independently established in this review.
No production deployment or public browser verification was performed by this reviewer.
The five decisions cover only one exact checkthrough runout, not all BTN-BB boards, bet-response branches or the full HU tree.
Numerical completeness and fluent matching English/Japanese text do not establish correctness of a strategic reason.
next_step: Keep main release on hold. Any correction must use explicit versioning and appropriately scoped reevaluation/review; no regeneration or correction is authorized by this report.
